actions.action: Track progress for each requested item
actions.mechanism: Calculate received and outstanding quantities from allocated physical receipts, keeping supplier promises in separate fields.
actions.implementation: Add a shared line-item register showing requested, confirmed, received, outstanding, and excess quantities. Sum multiple deliveries; link each receipt.
actions.check: Request ten units, confirm ten, and receive four then three. Outstanding must show ten, six, then three.
actions.risk: Inconsistent units can corrupt totals; specify units per line.

actions.mechanism: A named teammate other than the requester approves or rejects each replacement, preserving the decision rationale.
actions.implementation: Record original and replacement IDs, quantity conversion, requester, decision owner, decision, and rationale. Block self-approval; keep unapproved arrivals pending.
actions.check: Attempt requester approval and verify rejection. Independent approval must preserve rationale and count only quantities evidenced by receipts.
actions.risk: Owner absence can stall work; designate another eligible teammate.

actions.mechanism: Stable receipt-line identifiers prevent repeated entry from increasing delivered totals while preserving genuinely separate deliveries.
actions.implementation: Require supplier, receipt number, and line identifier; block repeated keys. Flag matching attachments or suspicious quantity/date matches for review.
actions.check: Enter the same receipt twice: totals must remain unchanged. Enter a separate identical-sized delivery: it must count once.
actions.risk: Missing supplier identifiers require locally assigned IDs and manual review.

actions.action: Route excess deliveries to explicit decisions
actions.mechanism: Preserve actual received quantities while flagging excess separately instead of hiding it through capped totals.
actions.implementation: Calculate excess against authorized quantities. Assign an existing teammate to record acceptance, return, or correction; retain original quantities and receipt links.
actions.check: Receive twelve against ten requested: show twelve received, zero outstanding, two excess, and an unresolved exception.
actions.risk: Do not infer permission to retain excess from receipt alone.

actions.mechanism: Allocation records connect physical item IDs to request lines without double-counting deliveries shared across requests.
actions.implementation: Record receipt-line-to-request-line quantities. Prevent allocations exceeding receipt quantities; place unmatched IDs in a review queue. Use approved mappings for substitutions.
actions.check: Split eight received units across two requests as three and five; reject a ninth allocated unit.
actions.risk: Similar item descriptions can cause misallocation; verify IDs and units.

actions.mechanism: Closure requires resolved quantities and exceptions; cancellations remain distinguishable from physically received goods.
actions.implementation: Allow remaining quantities to be canceled only with a named decision and reason. Block closure for unresolved substitutions, excess, or unmatched receipts.
actions.check: Receive six of ten and cancel four: show six received, four canceled, and closed—not ten received.
actions.risk: Premature cancellations can conceal shortages; keep closure history reviewable.

actions.action: Give every open exception a next step
actions.mechanism: A shared action queue turns ambiguous partial requests into named responsibilities and scheduled follow-ups.
actions.implementation: Create filtered views for shortages, substitution decisions, unmatched receipts, and excess. Require owner, next action, and due date; review together weekly.
actions.check: Seed one case of each type; verify all appear with owners. Resolving one must remove only that exception.
actions.risk: Stale assignments undermine visibility; review overdue entries explicitly.
